HM / HMP: Cortech Ligature Resistant Wall Hooks (Combined)
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-hm-ligature-resistant-hookmax-wall-hook
Manufacturer pages: https://cortechusa.com/products/facility-maintenance/ligature-resistant-hooks/hookmax/, https://cortechusa.com/products/facility-maintenance/ligature-resistant-hooks/hookmax-plus/
Spec sheets: HM, HMP
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Ligature Resistant Wall Hooks – HookMax / HookMax+ / HM / HMP
Current H1: Cortech Ligature Resistant HookMax Wall Hook - HM
Subtitle: Flexible Wall Hooks That Bend and Release at a Maximum 10 or 20 lb Load, Sold in Packs of 5
Current subtitle: Cortech USA HM Hookmax Anti-Ligature Hooks
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Ligature Resistant Wall Hooks hold clothing and towels in resident rooms, bathrooms, and common areas of behavioral healthcare and correctional facilities. The HookMax releases at a maximum load of 10 lbs and the HookMax+ at 20 lbs: the hook bends, the item or ligature slides off, and the hook returns to its shape.
Both hooks have a PC/ABS core with a flexible TPU outer piece that helps prevent injury, and they release in all directions, so they can be placed close to furniture and doors. They come in five colors and are sold in packs of 5.
Models: HookMax (HM) releases at a maximum 10 lb load; HookMax+ (HMP) releases at a maximum 20 lb load
Material: PC/ABS core with a flexible TPU outer piece
Dimensions: 1.24”W×0.85”D×2.05”H (each hook)
Release: Releases in all directions (360°), then returns to its shape
Testing: Load release tests with a string release the HookMax at a maximum of 10 lbs and the HookMax+ at a maximum of 20 lbs
Mounting: Mount to a flat surface so the hook fits tightly against the wall
Care: Resistant to alcohol and most detergents
Colors: White, Gray, Black, Beige, or Magenta
Packaging: Sold in packs of 5. Price is per pack
Warranty: 3-year warranty for the intended use; full warranty against manufacturing defects
Country of Manufacture: Designed and produced in Sweden
Available Models and Options
HM – HookMax, 5 Pack: HMWH - White, HMGY - Gray, HMBK - Black, HMBE - Beige, HMMG - Magenta
HMP – HookMax+, 5 Pack: HMPWH - White, HMPGY - Gray, HMPBK - Black, HMPBE - Beige, HMPMG - Magenta
[H2] Applications
The HookMax and HookMax+ suit rooms where residents need a place to hang clothing and towels without creating a ligature point.
Typical applications include:
Resident rooms and bathrooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Cells and common areas in correctional facilities and jails
Residential treatment centers and shelters
Explore Anchortex's Hardware for Behavioral Health Care Facilities and Prison & Detention Hardware & Equipment collections for more ligature resistant hardware.
[H2] About Cortech HookMax Ligature Resistant Hooks
Cortech HookMax hooks hold clothing and towels, but bend and release when extra force is applied, so a ligature slides off. After release, the hook returns to its shape and keeps working. They suit resident rooms, bathrooms, and common areas in behavioral healthcare and correctional facilities.
The HookMax line includes:
HookMax: Releases at a maximum 10 lb load
HookMax+: Releases at a maximum 20 lb load
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (61 characters): Cortech Ligature Resistant Wall Hooks - HM / HMP at Anchortex
Meta description (159 characters): Shop Cortech HookMax and HookMax+ ligature resistant wall hooks, flexible hooks that bend and release at a 10 or 20 lb load so ligatures slide off. Packs of 5.
Notes and Questions
Combined page: as you asked, this tab combines the HookMax (HM) and HookMax+ (HMP) on the HM page and keeps its address. The HMP page was deleted and redirected (your note).
H1: I used your wording.
Variants: you gave two SKUs, so there are two variants: "HM - Pack of 5" (C601082-01) and "HMP - Pack of 5" (C601082-02), both at the current price of $196.80 (compare-at $246.00), since the two pages had the same price. You also said yes to color variants. Five colors for each hook would make 10 variants and need 10 SKUs, so for now I listed the colors and Cortech part numbers under Available Models. Would you like 10 color variants? If so, please give the SKUs.
Weight and size: the Cortech spec sheets do not give a weight, so both variants stay at 5 lbs. As you asked, the worksheet size is for a pack of 5, not one hook: I used 7”L×3”W×2”H as an estimate. Please correct it if you know the box size.
Testing: the HookMax spec sheet says the test used a string, shoelace, or rope made from bedsheets; the HookMax+ spec sheet says a string in vertical and horizontal directions. I kept one shorter line for both.
Mounting: the Cortech spec sheets say to mount the hook to a flat surface for a tight fit, but do not say how it attaches (screws or adhesive), so I left that out.
I fixed the typo "jailsg" in the Applications list.
Product images: the HM page has one image (HookMax). The HookMax+ photo was on the deleted HMP page. Would you like me to add a HookMax+ photo from the Cortech spec sheet?
